Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a sales tax exemption provided to state and local government on purchases made with debt proceeds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sales tax exemption provided to state andlocal government on purchases made with debt proceeds; adding a newsection to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to purchases, orportions of purchases, by state and local governments that wouldotherwise be subject to the tax under this chapter, when they arepurchased with moneys acquired by a state or local government fromindebtedness. (2) As used in this section "portions or purchases" are thoseportions of a purchase that were made from indebtedness when the totalpurchase was made from multiple fund sources. (3) As used in this section, "indebtedness" means all debt issuedby state or local governments for a term greater than one year and doesnot include debt to other governments or governmental funds. p. 1 SB 5993 (4) The exemption under this section is available only when thebuyer provides the seller with an exemption certificate in a form andmanner prescribed by the department. The seller must retain a copy ofthe certificate for the seller's files.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse of any items by state or local governments that otherwise would besubject to the tax under this chapter when the items were purchasedwith moneys acquired by a state or local government from indebtedness. (2) When the item used was acquired by purchase through multiplefunds sources, only the amount that was purchased by moneys acquiredfrom indebtedness qualify for the exemption under this section. (3) For the purposes of this section the definitions andrequirements in section 1 of this act apply.
